personal.name: Ashish Raj
personal.title: Enterprise Architect – Cloud, AI & Infrastructure
personal.summary: Enterprise technology architect with 16+ years of experience defining technology strategy, target architectures, and engineering roadmaps across cloud, networking, security, AI infrastructure, and observability for global organizations. Currently leading Cloud & AI Foundation architecture — establishing enterprise AI platforms (Microsoft Foundry, Azure Databricks) alongside cloud foundation services at production scale. Proven track record in platform consolidation, technology standardization, and cross-domain alignment within federated enterprises.

community: Microsoft Azure Cloud Leader Group Member

experience.title: Lead Architect – Cloud & AI Foundation
bullets: Lead architecture of Cloud & AI Foundation, owning the design, evolution, and long-term technology roadmap of enterprise Azure platforms, AI infrastructure, and shared foundation services.

Define target technology architectures and reference architectures across cloud, runtime, networking, and engineering platforms — establishing golden paths and technology standards for engineering teams.

Architect the AI Foundation for the organization, establishing Microsoft Foundry as the enterprise AI platform and Azure Databricks as the Data platform, defining patterns for identity, networking, data access, security, and governance for AI workloads.

Design and architect Azure Landing Zones and core foundation services using Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Sentinel (SIEM), Virtual Networks, and Azure-native governance and security controls.

Architect and enable Platform Engineering capabilities using DevOps and GitOps methodologies, delivering secure, scalable, and repeatable deployments through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Azure Bicep) and CI/CD pipelines.
Moderate cross-domain technology decisions, aligning engineering, network, security, data, and AI teams toward a unified technology direction.
Ensure the technology foundation supports AI readiness, resilience, sovereignty, and cloud economics (FinOps), balancing innovation with operational stability.
Translate business ambition into technology roadmaps, aligning Cloud & AI Foundation strategy with senior stakeholders and management.
Drive platform consolidation and technical debt reduction across the technology landscape, setting standards and deciding on justified exceptions.
Work closely with third-party vendors and system integrators, coordinating architecture design, technical alignment, and delivery planning.
Collaborate with governance and security bodies (Architecture Review Board, InfoSec) to deliver compliant, audit-ready, and enterprise-grade cloud and AI foundations.
